description: Verify a Japan qualified-invoice-issuer registration number (インボイス登録番号, "T" + 13 digits) against the National Tax Agency registry — no OCR. Returns active/cancelled/not-found, registration date, registered name, corporate registry record, and an optional fuzzy name-match. Cheapest pre-payment counterparty check for Japanese invoices. Cost: $0.01 (x402/USDC).

name.description: Issuer name to fuzzy-match against the registered name

number.description: Registration number, e.g. T1180301018771 (leading T optional)

name: verify_japan_invoice_number
